videos.script: Chat Completions is the shape the industry copied. {{one-client}} One client, seven providers, three things changed per provider: an address, a key and a model name. Everything else, the same code. {{ignored}} But the same shape is not the same behaviour. A field one provider honours, another ignores without a word. Compatible means the request is accepted, not that it is obeyed, so the evaluation runs again on every provider, through the path the program will use.
